questions.stem: Case 0201: Harborview Company reports total assets of $14,400 and total liabilities of $6,650. What is total owner's equity?

options.misconception: reports the liability figure as if it were the residual equity
adds liabilities to assets instead of subtracting them
subtracts assets from liabilities and reverses the equation

questions.explanation: The accounting equation states that assets equal liabilities plus owner's equity, so equity is the residual $14,400 minus $6,650, which is $7,750. questions.stem: Case 0202: Harborview Works has total liabilities of $7,400 and owner's equity of $13,150. What amount of total assets must appear on its balance sheet?

questions.stem: Case 0208: Which statement about a trial balance is correct for Fairview Manufacturing?

Equal totals prove that every transaction was recorded correctly

questions.stem: Case 0209: On July 17, 2024, Northfield Group pays $4,950 of rent covering the current month. Which accounting principle justifies recording the full amount as this month's expense?

options.text: The matching principle, which links costs to the period benefited
The cost principle, which records assets at historical cost
options.misconception: applies the historical cost rule to an expense timing question

options.text: The business entity principle, which separates owner and firm
options.misconception: names the entity assumption instead of the period matching rule

options.text: The revenue recognition principle, which governs sales timing
